entities.name: Unnur Brá Konráðsdóttir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Unnur Brá Konráðsdóttir is an Icelandic politician. She served as the Speaker of the Althing from the 24th of January 2017 until she failed to be re-elected in the 2017 Icelandic parliamentary election. She has also served as the chair of the Parliament's Judicial Affairs and Education Committee.
